objectives.description: Meaning and scope of basketry: areas covered — coiled work, woven articles, frame works, macrame etc.; making articles such as baskets, hats, mats, nets, couch, footwear, cot etc.

Rationale for studying basketry: creative use of new materials for making articles of cultural, functional and aesthetic value; skills acquisition for employment and further studies; tourism promotion.
History — origin of basketry; social use of basketry e.g. entertainment etc.; cultural importance of basketry; economic importance of basketry in society e.g. in agriculture and commerce.
Places, people and basketry: contribution of people and places to basketry.

Competencies and attitudes: knowledge, creative thinking, skill and values for employment e.g. weaving, designing etc.; tolerance, diligence, honesty, commitment etc.; communication skills, time-management etc.

subStrands.name: Types of Materials, Preparation, Care and Tools

objectives.description: Types and characteristics of materials: natural, synthetic, flexible/pliable, stiff/rigid etc.

Preparation of materials: skills and techniques for preparation e.g. drying, wetting; storage and care of materials (chemical and non-chemical methods); preservation of sources of materials e.g. ecology, bush burning etc.; discovering characteristics of materials and their uses.
Tools and their uses: category of tools, description and uses; drawing and labelling; improvisation; care/maintenance and safety precaution.

subStrands.name: Elements, Principles of Design and Basic Design Technology

objectives.description: Elements of design: identifying the elements and principles of design in the environment e.g. dot, line, shape etc.; creating the elements using appropriate techniques of knotting, weaving etc.; 12-point colour wheel.

Principles of design: identifying the principles of design in the environment e.g. unity, balance, proportion, repetition etc.; creating the principles using appropriate techniques e.g. spraying, scorching, weaving etc.
Basic design and technology: definition of design; idea creation and design by drawing from memory, imagination and observation; use of appropriate techniques, tools and materials.

Designing articles to suit specific needs: designing an article by hand or computer; making articles to satisfy specific needs using techniques in weaving, knotting, plaiting, coiling and stitching, framing etc.; criteria for appreciation and evaluation e.g. appropriate material, colour, technique, finishing etc.

Decoration and finishing: definition of decoration and finishing; processes of decoration e.g. use of coloured and uncoloured weavers, weave variations, scorching, spraying and use of complementary objects etc.; processes of finishing e.g. wrapping, binding, singeing, tying, trimming, lashing, bending, glueing, sanding, varnishing, lacquering, embroidering, sealing, borders etc.

Sustainable development of basketry: exploring strategies of sustaining sources of raw materials e.g. re-aforestation, waste management etc.; challenges — identifying and seeking solutions to problems associated with the industry e.g. competition with plastic products, material acquisition etc.; solution — formation of co-operatives, remaining competitive.

subStrands.name: Business Plan, Capital, Exhibition, Costing and Pricing

objectives.description: Portfolio: prints, photos, CDs, DVDs etc.
Business plan: meaning, purpose for business plan, steps towards business organization e.g. registration of business, capital, location of set-up, materials and tools, market survey etc.
The business: capital e.g. bank loan, co-operatives etc.; exhibition — types e.g. general and specialized; business promotion e.g. billboard, internet, print media, TV, radio, handbills, posters etc.
Packaging and handling: definition, function, disadvantages; types of packaging — primary, secondary and tertiary packaging.
Costing and pricing: variable cost, fixed cost, profit; factors of price determination.
